name: kitchen-sync
description: Fast efficiently sync database without dumping & reloading

repo.name: kitchen_sync
repo.description: Fast unidirectional synchronization - make or efficiently update a copy of a database, without slow dumping & reloading

readme.summary: Clear purpose and excellent conceptual overview, but relies heavily on external documentation files for practical details.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting guidance in main README and configuration options only mentioned via external filter file example

injection_risks.description: Potential SQL injection risk in the delete_range function due to string concatenation

critical_findings: Potential SQL injection risk in the delete_range function
Lack of input validation and sanitization
security.summary: The code has some security concerns, including potential SQL injection risks and lack of input validation, but no critical secrets or error exposure issues were found.

common_complaints: Edge case handling (NULL values, ENUM types, UUID sorting)
praise_themes: Core functionality works well for standard use cases
sentiment.summary: Kitchen Sync shows declining maintenance with multiple unresolved bugs spanning 2+ years, slow response times, and release management issues, though the tool remains functional for basic database synchronization tasks.

communication.summary: Maintainer responses are generally helpful and clear, showing patience with new contributors.
